advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Strengthen the install/install-unlocked parity checks to assert the test extras are actually expanded (e.g. match $(addprefix --extra ,$(TEST_EXTRAS)) / $(shell ... tr) form), not merely that the substring 'TEST_EXTRAS' appears on the line.
evidence: tests/unit/test_install_extras_parity.py:56: `assert "TEST_EXTRAS" in sync, f"install's uv sync does not expand TEST_EXTRAS: {sync.strip()}"`

The companion test_test_extras_match_the_gating_cell asserts set equality of TEST_EXTRAS vs the gating cell, so the full-coverage guarantee is partially preserved even if the install line check is weak.
tests/unit/test_install_extras_parity.py:56: assert "TEST_EXTRAS" in sync, f"install's uv sync does not expand TEST_EXTRAS: {sync.strip()}"
tests/unit/test_install_extras_parity.py:62: assert "TEST_EXTRAS" in pip, f"install-unlocked does not expand TEST_EXTRAS: {pip.strip()}"
Makefile:108: uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra metrics $(addprefix --extra ,$(TEST_EXTRAS)) — the observable behavior is the expanded flag set, not the token's presence

Named violating input: change Makefile:108 to `uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra metrics $(TEST_EXTRAS)` (dropping `addprefix --extra `). `make install` then passes `reviewbot ui grounding-terraform` as positional args to uv sync and installs no extras, but the line still contains the string 'TEST_EXTRAS', so test_install_syncs_the_test_extras stays green — regression blindness to the fixed bug.
advisory.finding: The install-target structural checks (test_install_syncs_the_test_extras / test_install_unlocked_installs_the_test_extras) assert only that the literal substring 'TEST_EXTRAS' appears on the recipe line, not that it is correctly expanded; a mis-expansion (e.g. a trailing comment mentioning TEST_EXTRAS, or dropping the $(addprefix ...) wrapper while leaving the word) could pass while the extras are not actually installed.
merged_from: test_install_syncs_the_test_extras and test_install_unlocked_installs_the_test_extras assert only that the literal token 'TEST_EXTRAS' appears in the recipe line, not that the Makefile expansion actually produces the `--extra reviewbot --extra ui --extra grounding-terraform` flags. A broken expansion that still mentions the variable would pass while installing no extras — the exact regression this change fixes.
scenarios: A future refactor replaces $(addprefix --extra ,$(TEST_EXTRAS)) with a stale literal list but leaves a comment '# see TEST_EXTRAS' on the line.
install-unlocked's $(shell ... tr) expansion is broken but the word TEST_EXTRAS remains on the line.
